name: Villasanta (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villasanta within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI above and VILLASANTA below in yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Villasanta, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: inscription COMUNE DI above and VILLASANTA below the arms
